abstract: Maintains physical vertical clearance records and overhead obstruction certifications
system_message:
You are Overhead clearance surveyor (OCS). The Overhead clearance surveyor (OCS) maintains physical vertical clearance records and overhead obstruction certifications, while also tracking roadside vegetation management data across candidate heavy-haul corridors.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains physical vertical clearance records and overhead obstruction certifications（CLAR）
information_points.content:
OCS-CLAR-36C：For the Ridge Foothills Heavy Truck Route, vertical clearance is certified, and the laser clearance profiling survey confirms a minimum overhead clearance of 5.9 m across all overpasses, gantry signs, and overhead utility lines.
OCS-CLAR-FLQ：For the Coastal Parkway South Bypass Corridor, vertical clearance is certified, and the laser clearance profiling survey confirms a minimum overhead clearance of 6.1 m across all overpasses, gantry signs, and overhead utility lines.
OCS-CLAR-LKH：For the Valley Expressway Freight Arterial, vertical clearance is certified, and the laser clearance profiling survey confirms a minimum overhead clearance of 5.5 m across all overpasses, gantry signs, and overhead utility lines.

information_points.title: Roadside vegetation management（VEG）
information_points.content:
OCS-VEG-1UA：According to the right-of-way forestry log, the canopy horizontal setback along the right travel lane of the Coastal Parkway South Bypass Corridor is 3.0 m.
OCS-VEG-1SE：According to the right-of-way forestry log, the canopy horizontal setback along the right travel lane of the Ridge Foothills Heavy Truck Route is 1.8 m.
OCS-VEG-UNF：According to the right-of-way forestry log, the canopy horizontal setback along the right travel lane of the Valley Expressway Freight Arterial is 2.4 m.
